content.text:
I fixed the About page on phones. A leftover rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css` set `.story` back to two columns (`1fr 480px`). It came after the phone breakpoint, so it overrode the single-column layout, and the 480px image column forced the page too wide on a phone. I deleted that rule.

All 12 visual tests pass against the existing baselines, with no changed or new snapshots, including About at phone size. That means the page now matches the approved phone layout again. I didn't run the functional tests, and I haven't looked at the page on a real device.

I haven't committed anything.
